evals.prompt: Our dashboard refreshes 40 tickers from Twelve Data every time someone opens it and we keep hitting rate limits. How should we restructure it?
evals.expected_output: Recommends batching, caching static data, sizing outputsize to what is displayed and watching /api_usage.
assertions: Recommends POST /batch instead of a per-symbol loop
Recommends caching data that does not change intraday
Mentions checking /api_usage against the plan limit
Does not simply suggest upgrading the plan as the only fix

evals.prompt: I am correlating a US stock with a European one from Twelve Data and the numbers look off even though both series have the same length.
evals.expected_output: Identifies mismatched trading calendars and timezones, and requires joining on the datetime index instead of by position.
assertions: Explains that equal length does not mean the same dates
Recommends joining on the datetime index
Addresses how missing rows are handled

evals.prompt: Some fields in the Twelve Data response come back as null. Should I default them to zero so the chart renders?
evals.expected_output: Says no, null means unavailable and substituting zero creates a fake price move; the gap should be surfaced instead.
assertions: Advises against replacing null with zero
Explains that null means the metric is unavailable rather than an error
Suggests surfacing the gap in the output
